activation_flow: CODE_86AAB0 reads 1E6C plus (22 << 1) into local F4
CODE_869E48 copies F4 to D0 and stores D0 at 1E6C plus (22 << 1)
the index expression selects word 1E6C or 1E6E for observed 22 values 0 or 1
CODE_83D920 visits both word selectors through DATA_81B0BB and activates direct pages 08A0/08D0 through DATA_81B0BF when the corresponding value is non-negative
the loader sets 11FA bit 0001, initializes local 26 to 0040 and local 2E to zero

script_transfer.guard: CODE_86:AA91 counts whether local indexes 48 and 4A are at least 11; transfer occurs only when count equals 1
script_transfer.value_encoding: bytes read from script pointer 28 are masked with 1F before writing trajectory words
script_transfer.target_words: writes 1E6C plus a 22-derived offset and the adjacent byte/word position selected by index thresholds
script_transfer.related_marker: CODE_86:AB0F tests and transfers bit 20 between the same script-byte positions

limitations: The script/interpreter meaning that supplies F4 is unresolved; this does not identify pass, shot, bounce, or net events.
The valid domain and semantics of local 22 require runtime evidence beyond the observed two selector words.
The script byte format proves low-five-bit transfer and bit-20 handling, but not the gameplay meaning of each encoded value.
No browser trajectory is replaced until coordinate and velocity sources are recovered.
